title: Life-changing.
body:
I used to write reminders in my notes but this is much more satisfying and effective to use for reminders and tasks of all sorts. Really easy to use and navigate after a few days of getting used to it. Todoist has been extremely helpful for me!

title: Winning Productivity App
body:
I've been in search of the perfect To-do List App for a year now and by far Todoist is one of the two apps that is working well for me.

Its interface and features are smart, neat, and professional. I like that you don't need to subscribe to use its functionality. Although I do have plans to subscribe to a productivity app, I just wish they could give us the "option" for a month/calendar view while also allowing us to view previous months. It would be nice to have an overview of a month “within” the app. That would definitely be the one thing that lacks to make this the best productivity app for me.

title: I love the labels.
body:
I’ve been looking for a to-do list app that had a proper labelling and sorting system that has the display functions I liked that weren’t locked behind a subscription and this fit the bill! It’s been a great help getting me organized for schoolwork.

One thing, I wish the ‘Show completed tasks’ mode didn’t remove your sorting view. I have a great deal of labels and it would be an extreme help in situations where I know what I have already done, instead of resetting my viewing settings again and having to scroll down to the bottom just to see the mess of unsorted completed tasks down there. It would also be easier to recheck and uncheck items I thought needed some editing.

That’s the gist of my thoughts at the moment! I hope this feature can get sorted out in the future.

title: Best Cross Platform ToDo List
body:
I have always loved my Apple products unfortunately I have had to use Windows machines for work. I manage a lot of tasks at work and at home, requiring to me to have a consolidated ‘list’ of my todo’s. I used to depend on Things which syncs seamless between my Apple products. I have always wished for a ToDo list that will be able to sync to all devices that I use on a day-to-day basis. ToDoist is the answer! With or without Premium Membership, it syncs to both Mac and Windows!

Simplicity, power and ease in organisation and task management. Great product!
author: geepyo

title: More! :)
body:
I’ve always used Doit.im but when I saw ToDoist in the AppStore, I knew I had to give it a try. This app has a beautiful UI(iOS7 worthy) and is indeed functional.  I love the simplicity and easy navigation.

However, I still can’t let go of Doit.im because it’s much more comprehensive.  It has a better way and a lot more options of categorizing tasks - from specific duration dates to tags.
 
Also, I suggest that in completing a task, we don’t have to tap it first then tap complete.  I wish it has a single-tap-to-indicate-it’s-done system.  Moreover, there’s no option of indicating you have completed a Project or when it is due.  You just delete it.
 
Hope more improvements and options are on the way! 👍
author: +RG+

title: Disappointed (but still hopeful)
body: I was very hopeful for the iOS 7 version/look but was terribly disappointed. No to little change from the previous version. Minimalist yeah but not appealing at all (i.e. very boring). I'm a huge fan of Todoist (I went premium shortly after i discovered it) but the iPhone app just do not deliver. I can never understand why its hard for tasks within projects to automatically order by due date. A regular UX would realize that massive need. Ive set up my projects to define my workflow for the day but since within project i cannot order by time, todoist instantly becomes useless for me (which makes me really sad). I have no problems however with the web and mac app and im very satisfied actually because it serves this concern very well but i need it to work as effectively on my iphone. Pls help as soon as possible. Thank you.
